text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Fitted to past weather on a screening run, pooled fit P. Top: the daily profile (shared shapes mixed, plus the substation's own deviation) for weekdays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Bottom: the heating response, the slope times the degrees below the substation's threshold.'
text.tspan: Fitted to past weather on a screening run, pooled fit P. Top: the daily profile (shared shapes
mixed, plus the substation's own deviation) for weekdays, Saturdays, and Sundays. Bottom: the
heating response, the slope times the degrees below the substation's threshold.
